description: A family B is unbounded exactly when, for every function g, there is f in B that is not eventually dominated by g.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.isUnbounded_iff (B : Set (ℕ → ℕ)) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.IsUnbounded B ↔ ∀ (g : ℕ → ℕ), ∃ f ∈ B, ¬f ≤ᶠ[Filter.atTop] g
